title: Creamy Turkish Pide
description: A rich and creamy turkish pide recipe featuring a luxurious twist.
instructions: Roll out the pide dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spread the Turkish butter evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
In a separate bowl, mix the luxurious cream cheese, crumbled feta cheese, and chopped parsley until well combined.
Spread the cheese mixture over the butter-covered dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the cheese mixture with sliced potatoes and minced garlic.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the top of the pide with a little water and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Bake the pide in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pide from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
